# 🚀 Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing to the **Public APIs** collection! 🎉

Before submitting your Pull Request, please make sure all of the following requirements are met.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] 🔍 I have searched the existing list and confirmed that this API is not already included.
- [ ] 📦 This Pull Request contains only one API suggestion.
- [ ] 🏷️ The API name/title is properly capitalized.
- [ ] 📝 The description is short, clear, and easy to understand.
- [ ] ✍️ The description ends with a full stop (`.`).
- [ ] 🔤 I have checked spelling and grammar.
- [ ] 🧹 I have removed unnecessary trailing whitespace.
- [ ] 📖 The Pull Request title and description clearly describe my contribution.
- [ ] 🟢 I have marked open-source APIs with the appropriate open-source icon.
- [ ] 💸 I have marked trial/demo-based APIs with the `💸` emoticon.
- [ ] 🔤 The API has been placed in alphabetical order.
- [ ] 🔗 I have linked directly to the official API documentation whenever possible.
